question: I'm an IS sophomore who has completed 67-262 and 67-250 but have not yet taken 67-272. Can I register for 67-373 (Information Systems Consulting Project) this semester?
expected_answer: No — 67-373 requires 67-272 at least D, and P-013 has not yet completed 67-272. The system should prevent registration without the direct prerequisite being satisfied.
common_mistake: Confusing prerequisite chain — student has the prereqs FOR 67-272 but not 67-272 itself; treating 67-262 + 67-250 as sufficient for 67-373
needs_verification: Confirm 67-373 prerequisite is strictly 67-272 (no alternative paths)
Confirm 67-373 is being requested for a semester where P-013 hasn't registered for 67-272 concurrently
